title: Veggie Ground Soup with Tomatoes, Carrots, Green Beans, Peas & Corn

ingredients.name: Frozen Mixed Vegetables (carrots (corn, green beans, peas))

steps.text: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and veggie ground to the pot; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Add broth, frozen veggies, tomatoes, soy sauce, and spices to the pot, then stir to combine the soup. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until the veggies are soft, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the soup and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
